tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Euler characteristic in terms of homology] ↗ def:dimension-cw-complex 1. ch2:2.44\group Cellular Homology

For a finite CW complex, \[ \chi (X)=\sum _n(-1)^n\# \{ n\text{-cells}\} =\sum _n(-1)^n\operatorname {rank}H_n(X). \]
Proof

\sketch In a finite chain complex, use the short exact sequences $0\to Z_n\to C_n\to B_{n-1}\to 0$ and $0\to B_n\to Z_n\to H_n\to 0$, add the resulting rank identities with alternating signs, and apply this to the cellular complex.

□
